summary: STACK EMEA's three open searches are at the midpoint of outreach and landing well in the market; CVs coming in for second-stage deep dives. Promising DC-experienced prospects: James Miles (Utilities; worth running by Bobby Hollis), Matteo Bruno (Utilities), Eduardo Albuquerque (Regional Head of Development; Ward's first read is VP rather than SVP level; worth running by Josh Timberlake) and Andrea Menechini (VP Italy). Shortlist on course for w/c 16 November.
